description: Source code for handling mailmap functionality in a Git-related project, including reading, parsing, and managing mailmap entries and mappings.

classes.name: mailmap_info
classes.description: Holds name and email information for mailmap entries.

classes.name: mailmap_entry
classes.description: Represents a mailmap entry, including name, email, and a list of name mappings.

methods.name: free_mailmap_entry
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for mailmap_entry and its components.

methods.name: namemap_cmp
methods.description: Comparison function for string comparison, using strcasecmp.

methods.name: add_mapping
methods.description: Adds a new name/email mapping to a string_list.

methods.name: parse_name_and_email
methods.description: Parses a string to extract name and email components.

methods.name: read_mailmap_line
methods.description: Reads and processes a line from a mailmap file.

methods.name: read_mailmap_file
methods.description: Reads a mailmap file and populates the string_list with entries.

methods.name: read_mailmap_string
methods.description: Reads mailmap data from a string buffer.

methods.name: read_mailmap_blob
methods.description: Reads mailmap data from a blob object in the repository.

methods.name: read_mailmap
methods.description: Main function to read mailmap data from various sources.

methods.name: lookup_prefix
methods.description: Finds a map entry matching a prefix of a string.

methods.name: map_user
methods.description: Maps a user's email and name to their mapped equivalents if present.
